name: Prosperity Dielectrics Co., Ltd.
summary: Prosperity Dielectrics Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, and sells chip capacitors, chip resistors, dielectric ceramic powder, and magnetic components in Asia, the United States, and Europe.
